nvidia_h200.notes: SXM vendor sparse rates divided by two for dense arithmetic. Capacity uses the existing binary allocation convention.

nvidia_a800.notes: Table 2, 80 GB SXM column and dense Tensor Core rates.

ascend_910b.notes: Tensor envelope derived from Huawei CANN's pinned B2 platform declaration: 24 Cube cores x 1.8 GHz x 2 x 16 x 16 x 16 FLOP. Huawei Atlas 800T A2 User Guide v20 section 3.1 gives the 64 GB and 1600 GB/s HBM interface; its selectable 313/376 FP16 bins have no named B2 mapping.

metax_c500.notes: Compute and bandwidth use the 350 W product card reproduced on page 1 of the distributor sheet. The retained architecture/matrix benchmark supports the rounded 240 TFLOP/s envelope. The MetaX optimization guide separately cites 1.55 TB/s; that figure is not used for this nameplate profile.
